class Solution:
    def modify(self, root):
        self.sum = 0
        
        def reverse_inorder(node):
            if not node:
                return
            reverse_inorder(node.right)
            self.sum += node.data
            node.data = self.sum
            reverse_inorder(node.left)
        
        reverse_inorder(root)
        return root
